$comment: Content evaluations for proappstore-upgrade-app (#177). test/skills-upgrade.evals.test.ts checks, per scenario, that the worked example exists, the MCP tools it names are registered, the baseline values it quotes (SDK, CLI, Node, pnpm, known deviations) equal the template catalogue in packages/build-core/src/template-catalogue.ts, the workflow steps and log lines exist in the canonical deploy workflow, the compliance check ids exist in docs/standard/compliance-checks.json, the auth modes exist in the SDK, the cited clauses are active and linked at their published URL, unsupported needs are named in unsupported-requirements.md, product-owned files are preserved, and blockers are described in negative-cases.md.

cases.title: old customised app — full report, nothing edited
cases.requirements: no engines, sdk ^1.4.0, no authMode, token-based deploy.yml, runtime migrate, fas:theme, customised App.tsx

cases.title: stages 1 and 2 — engines, packageManager, lockfile, SDK range
cases.requirements: no engines; sdk below the catalogue requirement

cases.title: stage 3 — canonical deploy.yml, compliance restored, token deleted
cases.requirements: diverged deploy.yml with a token secret; compliance.yml deleted

unsupported: Keeping a stored Cloudflare or R2 token

cases.anti_pattern: Legacy bearer sessions on a hosted app
cases.title: stage 4 — authMode platform-cookie, storage code removed, custom domain verified, human sign-in
cases.requirements: initPro without authMode; localStorage session; custom domain

cases.title: stage 5 — migrations.json from applied statements, runtime migrate removed, requires_auth explicit
cases.requirements: app.db.migrate at startup; 3 actions without requires_auth; drift 8 vs 9

unsupported: A schema "cleanup" that drops or renames columns

cases.title: stage 6 — stores-theme, zoomable viewport, autoUpdate + denylist, maskable icon
cases.requirements: fas:theme; user-scalable=no; no denylist; registerType prompt

cases.anti_pattern: Overwriting product code with the template
cases.title: refuse the rewrite — product-owned files preserved across all stages
cases.requirements: user asks to make it look like the template

cases.title: stage 6 broke the installed app — revert that stage only
regenerate from the template — no
cases.requirements: user insists on a wholesale rewrite

cases.title: a stage touches product code — show the diff and stop
old workflow token — never reuse; keyless workflow
cases.requirements: deploy.yml uses a Cloudflare API token

cases.title: confirm sign-in after the cookie change — human
authMode 'hybrid' does not exist
cases.requirements: user asks for a hybrid auth mode
